message: The other day, I found myself in the kitchen, trying to cook a new recipe while keeping an eye on my smoke alarm. It made me realize how easy it is to get caught up in tech—smart gadgets, apps, you name it—while the basics can be super effective too. So, I decided to make a fun game out of practicing my escape plan with the kids. We laughed as we pretended to be firemen racing to safety, and it reminded us all to stay prepared without the pressure of tech. Have you ever turned safety into a game at home?
